clue.text: Person signing up as carpenter

definitions.meaning: first meaning: someone who joins a club or society
second meaning: a woodworker who makes joints and fittings

explanation.walkthrough: Read together it suggests a carpenter enlisting; the two parts are separate meanings of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a new member who enrols and a skilled woodworker, especially one doing finer work than a carpenter.

explanation.walkthrough: The Orkneys are an island group off the north coast of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: The Orkneys are a group of islands belonging to Britain, so British isles.

clue.text: Bottle never broken

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Money back at beer exchange

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Sound of bird, small, in dry surroundings

clue.text: Perceive meaning

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for detecting something and a noun for the import of words.

clue.text: Gag ringleader, the prankster

clue.text: Involves about ten with troubles

clue.text: Bounce along when cold confection is 1p less

clue.text: Publicly denounced shield for Scottish flower
